newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain, Endesa to tell of important deal at 1515 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Spain, Endesa to tell of important deal at 1515 GMT.

text.p: Spanish state holding company Sociedad Estatal de Participaciones Industriales (Sepi) and electricity firm Endesa on Friday called a joint press conference to announce an "important financial operation", Sepi said.
The conference will take place at 1715 local time (1515 GMT).
Endesa chairman Rodolfo Martin Villa, chief executive Rafael Miranda and Sepi chairman Pedro Ferreras will give the announcement, a statement from Endesa said.
Sepi still owns nearly 67 percent of Endesa. A public share offering for between 25 and 35 percent of the utility is planned in the autumn.
